description: Open Data Portal Catalogue Metadata is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction A special dataset that contains metadata for all the published datasets. Dataset profile fields conform to Dublin Core standard. Other You can download metadata for individual datasets, via the links provided in descriptions. Definitions of key terms related to this dataset can be found in the Open Data Portal Glossary:. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Supporting Information. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
